title: The UI has an error boundary
rationale: One thrown render error must not blank the application or lose user data.

title: Routes and heavy views are lazy-loaded
rationale: Start-up cost is paid once per user; code they never open should not be in it.
hint: Local-only builds are one file and cannot be split, so this applies to hosted apps.

title: React hooks rules are linted
rationale: Hook-order bugs are crashes that only appear on some renders.

title: React is on the current major
rationale: Old majors lose security fixes and ecosystem support.

title: Performance budgets are checked
rationale: Speed regresses by small steps nobody notices; a budget turns it into a failing check.
hint: Fail CI when the main bundle or start-up time exceeds the agreed budget.
